dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the lighter central dorsal axis and slightly darker peripheral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark, thin longitudinal linear mark is visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, well-defined dark linear scar or rake mark located on the posterior dorsal surface.
